text: I don't think I would buy an expensive watch even if I were rich, but maybe it's an identity symbol, you know?

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Like how some girls buy luxury bags.

speaker: A

text: I think expensive watches are the same thing for some men — a way to show their status.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: And I've also heard that some rich people buy expensive watches and jewelry because if something bad happens, they can just grab them and run — they're portable, and worth more than gold by volume.

speaker: A
